## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality or platform adapter)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement / refactoring

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and conventions of this project.
- [ ] I have verified that all TypeScript types compile without errors (`npm run lint`).
- [ ] I have added unit tests in `src/__tests__/` to cover new functionality or edge cases.
- [ ] All unit tests pass locally (`npm test`).
- [ ] I have built the extension bundle (`npm run build`) and manually verified functionality in Chrome.
- [ ] Any relevant documentation (e.g. `README.md`, `doc/` files) has been updated.
- [ ] I have signed off my commits using the Developer Certificate of Origin (`git commit -s`).
